ds-samples-time.rationale: Regular snapshots map values, indices and the external timing schedule. The explicit fast-motion limit correctly prevents an inference that regular measurements recover intervening behaviour; all timing facts remain visible.

ds-sines-phase.rationale: The rotating hand maps rotation rate to frequency, initial direction to phase and vertical projection to sine; the geometric-representation limit is accurate. Required controls and phase examples remain outside.

ds-sampling-aliasing.rationale: Film frames sample wheel position and can hide extra turns. Exposure blur and visual features explicitly limit the comparison; the technical equal-samples claim and its cosine/phase assumptions remain outside.

ds-quantisation-clipping.rationale: Ruler marks represent level spacing and its endpoint represents a range limit. The stated limit correctly rejects a random/independent-error inference; grid and clipping facts needed by questions are visible.

ds-mean-rms.rationale: Equal east/west signed positions illustrate cancellation, while RMS squares excursions and peak takes the farthest position. The limit correctly distinguishes RMS from travelled distance or journey length. This conceptual addition improves the measurement distinction; all definitions stay visible.

ds-decibels.rationale: Not needed: concrete measured ratios, equal-resistance voltage/power example and peak-meter reference already give the familiar context. An extra scale comparison would add no mechanism and could obscure the power/amplitude distinction.

ds-signal-operations.rationale: A recorded announcement shifted later maps a pure delay and explains cropped versus extended output windows. Its limit excludes echoes, speed changes and physical sound propagation; required zero-extension and tail policies remain visible.

ds-complex-components.rationale: Equal-scale east/north coordinates accurately map perpendicular components, magnitude and reflection across the real axis. The explicit multiplication limit avoids treating all complex arithmetic as map placement. The main text supplies the geometry independently.

ds-correlation.rationale: An unreversed transparent pattern maps template position and alignment; the limit names negative products, amplitude weighting and cancellation, so visual resemblance does not substitute for the numerical mechanism. Lag and arithmetic definitions stay visible.

corrections: Peak amplitude dictionary alias pointed to the largest recorded sample, conflicting with an ideal sinusoid parameter → move it to the general signal-amplitude entry, which explicitly distinguishes ideal, sampled-peak and RMS conventions.

Gain/mix/delay and rotating-phasor formula cards left index domains implicit → state finite retained-output indices and sample counts, and explicitly allow every integer for the unbounded phasor sequence.

Missing precise glossary aliases caused absent or cross-course lookups → add singular sample, sample interval/sampling interval, integer sample index, phase shift(s), amplitude gain, zero-extended, finite summation and capital/uppercase sigma. Avoid bare sigma because lowercase sigma can denote standard deviation.

Some glossary sources were broad or lacked the actual attached definition → point SI units/radian to fetched NIST SP330, white noise to Smith CH9, clipping/roll to exact NumPy API pages, array operations to NumPy quickstart, SciPy scope to signal reference and floating-point behaviour to the Python tutorial.
Samples-per-cycle glossary divided by frequency without stating its nonzero domain → limit the definition to positive-frequency sinusoids.

[Qualification] The metadata-frequency quiz made a universal statement about finite sine samples → require a known nonzero cycles-per-sample frequency and explicitly avoid claiming unique recovery of the original continuous tone.

coverageExceptions: How it maps and Where it stops are mandated disclosure labels rather than vocabulary.

ds-samples-time.rationale: Regular snapshots distinguish the sample value, index and externally supplied time schedule. The limit correctly states that equally spaced measurements do not guarantee recovery of intervening motion; required timing formulas remain outside.

ds-sines-phase.rationale: A constant-length rotating clock hand separates frequency from starting phase; its vertical projection follows sine. The limit makes rotation a geometric representation rather than a physical requirement.

ds-sampling-aliasing.rationale: Film frames sample wheel position, so additional turns between frames can be indistinguishable. The explicit exposure/visual-feature limit avoids claiming every observed video detail is an ideal scalar sample.

ds-quantisation-clipping.rationale: A finite ruler separates spacing between marks from its endpoint. The limit correctly refuses to infer random or independent quantisation error from the analogy; full quantiser rules and quiz facts stay visible.

ds-mean-rms.rationale: No analogy needed: two explicit finite-record contrasts directly show sign cancellation, offset removal and squaring. An extra comparison would not improve this calculation-focused objective.

ds-decibels.rationale: No analogy needed: positive ratios, explicit references, whole numerical calculations and zero-display policy teach the logarithmic convention directly. A generic scale metaphor could hide the amplitude/power distinction.

ds-signal-operations.rationale: Placing an announcement later on a timeline maps a pure delay and explains why retaining the old output interval crops a tail. The limit explicitly excludes echoes, speed changes and propagation mechanisms.

ds-complex-components.rationale: Equal-scale east/north coordinates map the perpendicular real/imaginary components and3-4-5 magnitude; north/south reflection maps conjugation. The stated multiplication limit avoids treating all complex arithmetic as simple map placement.

ds-correlation.rationale: Sliding an unreversed transparent pattern maps template position and lag. The limit names negative products, weighting and cancellation, so visual alignment does not substitute for the stated numerical sum.
